# Embedded Unicode fixture font

Noto Sans Regular, retrieved 2026-10-18 from the upstream Noto project:

- Font: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/notofonts/noto-fonts/main/hinted/ttf/NotoSans/NotoSans-Regular.ttf
- License: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/notofonts/noto-fonts/main/LICENSE
- Font SHA-256: `b85c38ecea8a7cfb39c24e395a4007474fa5a4fc864f6ee33309eb4948d232d5`
- License SHA-256: `0dab92d0544f7b233403f14b84a663bdbfa746982eda629e7f4f9ffe1b036feb`

The original font and SIL Open Font License are retained here. It is embedded, subsetted, in the synthetic Unicode extraction fixture by `@pdf-lib/fontkit`. The font is not used for application UI or requested from an external service at runtime. No customer content is in the fixture.
